decisive_items: Image Description: A 35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level.
Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100
response.rationale: Only one candidate provided; its raw spans directly support schwannoma via spinal location and S-100 positivity, with no contradicting spans.
